description: Answer cross-border money questions: deposit protection for non-residents, which schemes cover accounts held across borders. Returns sourced scheme information for both countries (from_country and to_country) with official regulator URLs and as_of dates. Covers US, UK, CA, AU, NZ. Free, no key. Unknown scenarios return not_in_catalog (never invents fees, FX rates, or coverage details).

from_country.description: Origin country code: US, UK, CA, AU, or NZ (e.g. "US" for US resident).

to_country.description: Destination country code: US, UK, CA, AU, or NZ (e.g. "UK" for UK bank account).

name: cross_border_check
title: Cross-Border Deposit Protection Check
